title: Jesus Loves Me
video_prompt: Cocomelon 3D style, a fluffy smiling baby lamb dancing on a sunny green hill with rolling clouds, a small wooden cross in the background, soft pastel colours, big friendly eyes, gentle bouncing to the beat, cheerful nursery-rhyme atmosphere, 16:9.
music_prompt: A gentle, cheerful children's nursery-rhyme version of 'Jesus Loves Me', soft xylophone and ukulele, sweet child-like vocals, slow 96 bpm, warm and comforting.

lyrics.text: Jesus loves me, this I know,
For the Bible tells me so.
They are weak but He is strong.
